params.prompt: Stylized blocky Roblox-style cartoon game UI concept art, 16:9 landscape phone game screen, matte flat colors, thick dark outlines, rounded panels, sticker-like cards, chunky bold readable text. Strictly NO neon, NO glow, NO bloom, NO lens flare, NO emissive light, NO glossy shine. Heist-comedy tone, kid-friendly, no blood, no weapons shown. Reward state system: 7 days; claimed days have a green check stamp, today is highlighted with a dark outline and a TODAY pill, locked days have a padlock pill. Includes a close X button top-right, a streak counter, and one big CLAIM button. Title lockup 'DEAD DROP' in bold stencil letters. Scene: a heist crew garage locker room, a row of 7 numbered metal lockers (1-7) standing in a line. Days 1-3 lockers hang open and empty with a CLAIMED stamp; day 4 locker is pulled slightly forward with a key tag and TODAY pill; days 5-7 locked with padlock pills; locker 7 is larger with gold trim. Warm off-white rounded side card titled 'DAY 4 REWARD' showing a kart decal sticker, button 'CLAIM'. Tally-mark streak '3 DAY STREAK'. Palette: warm off-white, charcoal, sky blue #56B4E9, orange #E69F00, green #009E73, pink-purple #CC79A7.
